$comment: Autonomy benchmark scenarios. target = the level a run should reach unattended (detect|cart|fill|buy). expectDeadEnd = the run PASSES iff it DRIVES the site and classifies that dead-end LIVE (registry data is only a hint; the run re-verifies it). allowBuy gates real-money submits (only in --buy mode, <= maxBuyPrice). Every scenario is exercised end-to-end — only add a dead-end scenario the harness can classify live (turnstile/paypal-only/captcha/stripe-config via classifyCheckoutSignals). Dead-ends the harness can't detect live (e.g. Shop Pay login-wall, which needs a page URL the SDK doesn't expose) live in the registry as recorded data, not here.

scenarios.notes: Verified WooCommerce+Stripe store (order #681199). Set country US first. Product URLs rotate — refresh via the Store API when add-to-cart fails.
WooCommerce PayPal PPCP, guestEnabled:false — driven to checkout, then classified paypal-only on the pristine checkout (no guest card frame). Live-verified 2026-07-13.
Big Cartel wizard; flaky load, invisible hCaptcha. Product URLs rotate.
